description: Address 5 review issues: pulse/filament bezier mismatch, per-frame allocation in discovery, phase timing desync, implicit coupling via universe.connectionPrediction, and dual discoveryRadius semantics.
steps: Fix PulseRenderer to accept and use the ConnectionRenderer's noise-displaced control point instead of raw midpoint
Fix getCandidateConnections() to expose backing array and count without .slice() allocation
Make Scene003Phases camera attention and ripple event-driven (triggered by ConnectionManager events) rather than fixed-time phase callbacks
Replace monkey-patching of connectionPrediction onto universe with explicit parameter passing through ConnectionManager.init()
Add defensive clamping in ConnectionManager.selectBestCandidate to use min(discoveryRadius, prediction.maxDistance) so discoveryRadius never exceeds the spatial query radius
acceptance_criteria: PulseRenderer travels on the same bezier path as the filament
No .slice() allocation during discovery phase frames
Camera attention and ripple only fire after ConnectionManager confirms CONNECTED state
No monkey-patching of universe object for connectionPrediction
ConnectionManager defensively caps discoveryRadius to prediction maxDistance
All files pass node --check syntax validation
findings: All 5 review issues resolved. ConnectionManager dropped from 394 to 383 lines by compacting constructor. getCandidateConnections uses pre-allocated result object - zero allocations in hot path. Phase callbacks in Scene003Phases now have null onEnter since camera/ripple are event-driven via ConnectionManager.on(). PulseRenderer accepts controlX/controlY params and no longer computes its own midpoint. Unused imports (lerp from ConnectionManager, settings from Scene003Phases) removed.
